svg.title: Complete Iraqi country, governorate and class wordmark proofs
svg.text: Each joined word is one proportional outline. All fallback words are HarfBuzz-shaped Noto Naskh Arabic Bold (SIL OFL 1.1).
These candidates are explicitly labelled; they do not turn missing source wordmarks into observed dies.
